# Release Notes House Voice

Write customer-facing release notes from commits, merged pull requests, closed tickets or a changelog, in the voice of your team's own past release notes: the skill first learns the house style from three to twenty published examples and writes a style card, groups changes by what users notice, translates each change into what the user can now do, drops internal-only changes into a separate author list, and flags anything it cannot explain — breaking changes and security fixes always — for confirmation with engineering instead of guessing.
